mined_features.name: Offline-cached search across 2,000+ tools
mined_features.description: The full tool catalog ships inside the app, so search and browse work instantly on install, before any network call succeeds — with typo-tolerant, synonym-aware search.
mined_features.differentiator: strong — most wrapper apps just point a WebView at a homepage

mined_features.name: Honest per-tool offline tracking (not a fake blanket claim)
mined_features.description: The app tracks which tools you've actually opened before and visibly dims + blocks ones never cached when you're offline, instead of pretending everything works without internet.
mined_features.differentiator: strong — the honest, correct version of an 'offline' claim

mined_features.name: Two-way favorites sync between app and web
mined_features.description: Favorite a tool in the app or on its web page and both stay in sync via an injected JS bridge — no server account needed.

mined_features.name: Native offline Date Calculator
mined_features.description: Computes date differences and add/subtract entirely on-device, zero network — genuinely useful for working out a due date or deadline offline.
mined_features.differentiator: table stakes but genuinely native, zero network

mined_features.name: Native offline Unit Converter (length/weight/temp/volume)
mined_features.description: Converts common units entirely on-device. Explicitly does NOT include currency conversion.
mined_features.differentiator: table stakes — and no currency conversion exists, don't imply otherwise

mined_features.name: Password generator that never shares the password itself
mined_features.description: Generates cryptographically secure passwords (Random.secure()) and deliberately blocks the Share button from leaking the actual password text — even analytics only logs the length.

mined_features.name: Photo-based color picker / eyedropper
mined_features.description: Pick the exact HEX/RGB/HSL/HSV color from any pixel of a camera photo or gallery image, with a live drag-magnifier, entirely on-device.
mined_features.differentiator: strongest hidden-gem feature in the app — a real design/dev tool buried in a calculator-branded app

mined_features.name: Full coin-toss decision game — the app's original identity
mined_features.description: Shake or fling to flip a coin (up to 6 at once), name what you're deciding, and unlock 11 achievements with day-streak tracking. This was the app before it became a calculator-branded utility.
mined_features.differentiator: strong content hook — 'your calculator app is secretly a full coin-flip game' — true, non-obvious, poor fit for financial branding, which is itself the story
